### **Company Overview**

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value where we support the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

### **Data & Analytics**

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

This role can be based in any of our US office locations and is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

**Accordion Intelligence Lab**

The AI Lab is composed of leading software and AI engineers, designing agentic-AI solutions ahead of the market. Our group builds and operationalizes the AI systems that power Accordion’s consulting capabilities, from agentic architectures and RAG pipelines to evaluation frameworks and production observability.

The Lab works closely with practice leaders to translate research findings into scalable, reliable tools that advance Accordion’s AI-driven value creation work for PE clients and their portfolio companies.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for an AI Product Manager to join one of Accordion’s new AI-augmented delivery pods—purpose-built teams that combine AI engineering, data science, and product management to transform how PE-backed companies run finance and operations.

In this role, you are the translation layer between client problems and AI system design. You don’t manage Jira tickets, you shape what gets built and why. You’ll run discovery sessions, write tight requirements, and keep sprints moving at a pace that only works if you’re using AI to think faster, write better, and communicate more clearly.

We move at sprint pace, not quarter pace. If you want to own outcomes end-to-end, work directly with PE clients, and build things that matter in finance, this is the role.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Interface with executive clients, garner trust in our services, and fill in your own knowledge gaps in real time.
* Translate ambiguous client problems into clear engineering requirements: PRDs, user stories and functional specs (and do it fast)
* Run client discovery sessions and earn trust quickly, including with CFOs and PE operators
* Own sprint planning and delivery coordination across your pod’s AI engineers and data scientists
* Define success criteria and KPIs for AI-powered features before they are built, not after
* Identify and communicate when an AI system isn’t performing reliably; bridge the gap between technical diagnosis and client-facing communication
* Use AI tools for 50%+ of your written output: requirements, stakeholder communications, research, and sprint planning
* Travel to client site as needed

**Success in the First 6 Months**

* Lead requirements and delivery coordination for at least one end-to-end AI engagement, from discovery through production
* Establish a reputation with your pod and with clients as someone who can run a room, write a tight PRD, and hold a sprint together
* Demonstrate materially faster output because of how you use AI tools, not just that you use them
* Show that you understand AI system behavior well enough to write requirements that aren’t naive about what LLMs can and can’t do

### **What You’ll Bring**

* AI tools are woven into how you work daily, you are materially faster because of it, and you can demonstrate that concretely
* 3–6+ years of PM or delivery management experience in a technical or AI product context
* PE or finance domain experience: FP&A, financial close, ERP systems, or finance transformation programs
* Background in consulting or professional services delivery
* Experience with the commercial dimension of AI products—thinking about adoption, product-market fit, and client value capture, not just delivery
* Demonstrated ability to translate messy, ambiguous business problems into clear engineering requirements
* Experience working directly with engineers on AI/ML or data-intensive products
* Strong written communication skills, you can write a tight PRD, user story, or functional spec (and you can do it fast)
* Comfort with iterative, sprint-based delivery under real time pressure. The world is changing around us, and you’ll drive our products as an agent of change.

This is a high-velocity environment. Sprints are short, client expectations are high, and we don’t slow down between engagements. If you’ve spent time in large enterprise engineering organizations where velocity is constrained by process, this will feel different.

The people who thrive here are those who find the pace energizing, not exhausting. They ship fast because they’ve internalized good judgment—not because they cut corners. They use AI tools to multiply their output, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and course-correct quickly when something isn’t working.

The annual salary for this role ranges from: $144,500 to $230,000 USD + significant bonus + benefits. Actual compensation packages are determined by evaluating a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to geographic location, skill set, years and depth of experience, education, certifications, cost of labor and internal equity.

Accordion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

About the Role

We're hiring a mid-level Product Manager to own and grow AI-driven features and products. You'll work across engineering, design, data science, and business stakeholders to identify problems worth solving with AI, define what "good" looks like, and ship products that actually work in production, not just in a demo.

This isn't a research role. You won't be building production models yourself. But we're not looking for someone who just writes PRDs and hands them off. We want someone who has actually gotten their hands dirty: built a prototype, chained some prompts together, used AI to automate a real workflow, or shipped a scrappy internal tool. If your AI experience is limited to writing requirements for a team that built the thing, that's not what we're looking for.

What You'll Do

Own the roadmap for one or more AI-powered product areas from problem definition through launch and iteration

Translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements and success metrics

Partner with engineering and data science teams to scope what's feasible, what's expensive, and what's a bad idea

Use AI tools yourself in your day-to-day work (research, drafting specs, analyzing data, prototyping) rather than treating AI as something other people build

Define and track metrics that matter: accuracy, latency, cost per query, user trust, adoption, not just "did we ship it"

Run structured experiments (A/B tests, phased rollouts) to validate whether AI features are actually improving outcomes

Manage tradeoffs between model quality, cost, latency, and user experience

Communicate clearly with both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders about what the AI is doing, why, and where it fails

Own the uncomfortable conversations when an AI feature underperforms or needs to be pulled back

What You Need

3-5 years of product management experience, with at least 1-2 years working on AI/ML-powered products or features

A concrete example of something you built or shipped using AI, not just specced. This could be a side project, an internal tool, a prototype using an LLM API, a workflow you automated, or a feature you personally prototyped before handing off for productionization. Be ready to walk through it in detail: what you built, what tools you used, what broke, what you changed

Working knowledge of how ML/AI systems are built and evaluated: enough to have informed conversations with data scientists and engineers, not enough that you need a CS degree

Strong written and verbal communication; you can explain a confusion matrix to an exec and a business requirement to an engineer

Track record of shipping products and owning outcomes, not just writing requirements for someone else to own

Comfortable with ambiguity. AI product work has a lot of "we don't actually know yet"

Nice to Have

Retail or e-commerce experience (merchandising, personalization, search/recommendations, inventory, or customer service AI applications)

Experience with LLM-based products specifically (chatbots, copilots, agents, RAG systems)

Familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, or model fine-tuning concepts

Experience working with responsible AI, fairness, or safety review processes

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

You've shipped or meaningfully improved at least one AI feature and can speak to its metrics with confidence

Engineering and data science trust your judgment on scope and tradeoffs

You've killed or paused at least one bad idea before it wasted engineering time

Stakeholders come to you for a straight answer on what the AI can and can't do

Salary Range

$100,000 - $130,000

Why Join Cogniify?

Own high-visibility engagements end to end, with direct exposure to Fortune 100 and global enterprise leadership.

A rare career path that combines deep technical ownership with genuine business and executive impact.

Work across diverse industries, technologies, and problem domains. No two engagements look the same, because no two solutions are the same.

Be part of building the playbook for a new category of technical role, not just executing an existing one.

Perks and Benefits of Working With Us

Unlimited PTO.

Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

Open communication with management and company leadership.

Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees.

Access to Disability & Life insurance.

Mental health and wellbeing support.

Annual bonus program.

Employer Stock Purchase Program (ESPP).

Yearly team building experiences.

Mentorship and sponsorship opportunities.

Manager resources and support.

Cogniify is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic

JOB SUMMARY
· Owns a major area of the BSWH AI use-case roadmap and is accountable for translating customer jobs-to-be-done into AI-powered experiences that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and business value.
· Leads prioritization, roadmap development, requirements definition, launch planning, and success measurement for AI-enabled capabilities across one or more customer journey areas.
· Works closely with Digital, Journey, Clinical, Analytics, Data, Ontology, Architecture, Engineering, and Operations teams to define, deliver, and continuously improve AI-powered customer experiences.
· Ensures AI capabilities solve meaningful customer problems, achieve measurable outcomes, and are designed for safe, scalable, and reusable implementation across BSWH use cases.
· Drives alignment across stakeholders while balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, operational constraints, regulatory requirements, and enterprise priorities.
· Partners with AI platform and architecture teams to leverage reusable AI capabilities while maintaining accountability for customer and business outcomes within the assigned product area.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE
AI Use Case Product Strategy & Roadmap
· Own the product strategy, roadmap, and backlog for one or more priority AI use-case areas.
· Translate customer, operational, and clinical problems into clear jobs-to-be-done, product requirements, delivery priorities, and measurable outcomes.
· Define success metrics and key performance indicators that measure business impact, customer value, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, and operational improvement.
· Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities where AI can create differentiated customer experiences or operational advantages.
· Develop business cases and prioritization frameworks that balance strategic value, implementation complexity, risk, dependency management, and expected return.
Customer Outcomes & Jobs-to-Be-Done Ownership
· Lead discovery efforts to understand customer needs, stakeholder requirements, operational workflows, and pain points that can be addressed through AI-enabled capabilities.
· Frame AI use cases as concrete customer jobs-to-be-done and ensure each use case has a clear problem statement, target outcome, measurable success criteria, and responsible stakeholders.
· Partner with customer journey leaders, clinical and operational subject matter experts, and analytics teams to validate that proposed capabilities address the right problems.
· Ensure product decisions stay grounded in customer value, clinical/operational integrity, and measurable business impact rather than technology novelty alone.
AI Capability Definition & Experience Design
· Define AI-enabled product capabilities, workflows, agent behaviors, escalation paths, guardrails, and customer experiences for assigned AI use cases.
· Translate strategy into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, success metrics, and delivery priorities that engineering and AI teams can execute against.
· Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to determine when solutions should use orchestration, retrieval, deterministic rules, personalization, automation, or human review.
· Partner with design, research, and customer experience teams to ensure AI-powered interactions are understandable, helpful, trustworthy, and aligned with BSWH experience standards.
Cross-Functional Delivery & Adoption
· Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Journey, Clinical, Analytics, Data, Ontology, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Operations teams.
· Manage roadmap tradeoffs across customer experience, speed of delivery, technical complexity, operational readiness, safety, compliance, and long-term scalability.
· Communicate product vision, roadmap priorities, delivery progress, risks, launch readiness, and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders.
· Support launch planning, adoption, training, stakeholder readiness, and operational handoffs for AI-enabled capabilities.
Evaluation, Measurement & Continuous Improvement
· Define expected AI behaviors, quality expectations, guardrails, and acceptance criteria in partnership with clinical, operational, technical, and AI quality stakeholders.
· Partner with engineering, analytics, and AI quality teams to establish evaluation approaches, testing criteria, performance expectations, and feedback loops.
· Monitor AI capability performance, adoption, customer outcomes, operational outcomes, and quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
· Drive iterative improvement using customer feedback, evaluation results, product analytics, operational insights, and experimentation results.
Platform Reuse & Enterprise Alignment
· Work with AI platform, architecture, data, ontology, and engineering teams to ensure assigned use cases leverage reusable enterprise AI capabilities where appropriate.
· Identify reusable capabilities, patterns, or requirements that should be shared across multiple AI use cases or product areas.
· Help prevent duplicated work by connecting use-case needs to common platform capabilities, integration patterns, evaluation approaches, and governance standards.
· Ensure product decisions support both near-term use-case delivery and BSWH’s longer-term AI strategy.
KEY SUCCESS FACTORS
· Proven ability to define product strategies that translate customer problems into measurable business and customer outcomes.
· Demonstrated success owning complex digital product areas with accountability for adoption, customer experience, and operational impact.
· Strong product judgment and prioritization skills, particularly in environments with competing stakeholder needs, technical uncertainty, and resource constraints.
· Ability to translate ambiguous customer, business, clinical, or operational needs into clear product requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans.
· Strong understanding of AI-enabled products and how AI capabilities can be used to improve customer journeys, operational processes, and decision support.
· Experience partnering with engineering, architecture, analytics, data, clinical, and operations teams to deliver complex technology-enabled solutions.
· Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to align diverse groups around common objectives without relying on formal authority.
· Ability to balance short-term delivery needs with long-term product, platform, and enterprise AI strategy.
· Comfort operating in a regulated or high-trust environment where safety, privacy, compliance, auditability, and customer trust are critical.
BENEFITS
Our competitive benefits package includes the following
- Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits
- 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%
- Tuition Reimbursement
- PTO accrual beginning Day 1
Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Education
· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
· Master’s degree preferred.
Experience
· 8–12 years of product management experience.
· Demonstrated ownership of digital products, platforms, customer experiences, or technology-enabled services with measurable business impact.
· Experience managing complex cross-functional roadmaps involving product, engineering, design, analytics, data, and business stakeholders.
· Experience working with AI-enabled products, machine learning systems, conversational experiences, personalization platforms, automation solutions, search experiences, recommendation systems, or decision-support technologies.
· Strong experience translating customer and business needs into structured product requirements, prioritized roadmaps, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
· Experience defining and measuring product success using KPIs, customer outcomes, business metrics, usage analytics, and qualitative customer insights.
· Healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated-industry experience preferred but not required.
Required Technical Expertise
· Strong understanding of AI-enabled product development and modern AI capabilities, including where AI can and cannot reliably improve customer or operational outcomes.
· Familiarity with concepts such as large language models, AI agents, orchestration, retrieval, personalization, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
· Product ownership across the full lifecycle, including strategy, discovery, requirements, prioritization, delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization.
· Experience working with APIs, integrations, enterprise systems, data products, analytics, and platform capabilities that support reusable product development.
· Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, architects, data teams, analytics teams, clinical stakeholders, and operational stakeholders.
· Strong analytical skills and comfort interpreting performance data, customer metrics, adoption trends, quality signals, and product outcomes.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
· Experience owning AI-powered customer experiences, digital assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, search experiences, workflow automation products, or decision-support capabilities.
· Experience applying Jobs-to-Be-Done, customer-centered design, design thinking, agile product development, or outcome-based product management methodologies.
· Familiarity with AI product evaluation approaches, including quality measurement, experimentation, benchmark definition, feedback loops, and performance optimization.
· Experience operating in healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or similarly regulated environments involving sensitive data, safety requirements, auditability, and compliance considerations.
· Experience launching products involving AI models, enterprise systems, APIs, cross-functional delivery teams, and operational adoption requirements.
· Experience working with product analytics, experimentation frameworks, customer research, behavioral insights, and customer experience measurement.
· Strong ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across business, technology, clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders.

Designs, plans, develops and manages a product or portfolio of products throughout the solution portfolio lifecycle: from new product definition or enhancements to existing products; planning, design, forecasting, and production; to end of life.

Contributions include applying developed subject matter expertise to solve common and sometimes complex technical problems and recommending alternatives where necessary. Might act as project lead and provide assistance to lower level professionals. ***This is a remote position within the United States.*** Candidates maybe required to work a hybrid schedule if within close proximity to an HPE Office.

* Defines the value proposition, target customer segments, and business case for platform capabilities and innovations, balancing customer outcomes with company-wide portfolio priorities, revenue impact, margins, and financial targets.
